text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp, wheeze*... Trainer... I did 
it, I really did it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I was able to run a race I can be proud 
of in this grand match before the gods. 
Now I can fulfill my natural lifespan..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I'm still alive, you know! Anyway, 
I'm completely full and thoroughly 
satisfied~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please don't thank me~. I only did 
what I could.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Our generation's Derby... I was able to 
erect a brilliant monument with you, 
Suzuka-san!
choice_data_list: Shall we move on to the next one?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, I suppose so... Still, the next 
one should definitely be easier...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Whaaat is this fortune reading...!? How 
terrifying... B-B-But there's no doubt 
about it!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Engraved upon the fortune stick is the 
historic Imperial Chrysanthemum crest. And 
what it points to is—!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyoeeeeh, anything but that, please! Gods, 
Buddha, and Trainer-sama~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to the Kikuka Sho, we're 
talking 3,000 meters, right? Plus tackling 
the slopes of Yodo! Even the slope to the 
underworld would be shocked!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
My luck's not gonna hold out over a 
distance that long~! Let's do something 
shorter...
choice_data_list: Well, that's just what the fortune said.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, that's true, isn't it? 'To advance 
or not to advance, fate decides.' In that 
case...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Got it~. Nothing to lose... or rather, 
it'll probably be totally hopeless, but 
I'll crash and burn trying~.
